**The report**
Attach the `<part>.report.json` written next to your STL. It contains the limits used, package versions and the position of every finding, and no folder paths.

**Did the part print?**
If you printed it: printer, nozzle, layer height, material, and what the print looked like at the place in question. A photo helps.

**The part**
Attach the STL if you can share it.
